title: privacy terms link outside label
rule: Privacy / terms link sits outside the label — not “I agree to the [privacy policy]” as a nested `<a>`. Put the link above, or in a fieldset description via `aria-describedby`.

citation.source: NL Design System — Niet in label

pass_when: Policy/terms link is above the control or in a fieldset description (`aria-describedby`), not nested in the `<label>`.
fail_when: A privacy/terms `<a>` is nested inside the agreement `<label>`.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: Labels-contain-only-text as this privacy-pattern row; contact pages.
